recent_excerpts: Kaspersky Compromise Assessment 2025 findings: 60% of incidents lacked high-confidence alerts; 30.8% of threats persisted over 3 months; 40% of web shells hid in backups.
Analysis of 25 million security alerts across enterprise environments shows defenders systematically ignore low-severity events, missing an average of one genuine threat per week.
SentinelOne research finds human-led security teams require 4-6 hours to validate a single alert, while automated attacks unfold in seconds, creating a critical defensive gap for enterprises.
